title: A channel in place of a COMMAREA: CHAR and BIT containers, APPEND, LINK / XCTL CHANNEL, the current channel, CONTAINERERR, CHANNELERR, LENGERR, INVREQ

scenarios.summary: CACHAN builds channel CAREQUEST (a CHAR container and an APPEND to it, a BIT container), LINKs CACHSUB with it -- which reads, truncates, misses, deletes and replies through its current channel -- reads the reply back, then XCTLs to CACHXB with the channel
GET CONTAINER of a container the channel does not have, with neither RESP nor HANDLE CONDITION: the task abends AEZJ
